chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn Abi Hamzah, from Ibn Abi Sa'id, from Aban ibn Taghlib, from Abu Abdullah (عليه السلام), who said:

When death came to Rasul Allah (صلى الله عليه وآله), Ali (عليه السلام) came in to him, and he drew his head near. Then he said: "O Ali, when I die, then wash me and shroud me, then seat me upright, ask me, and write."

key_terms.الْمَوْتُ: death at the moment of final departure
key_terms.فَغَسِّلْنِي: perform ghusl for me after death
key_terms.وَكَفِّنِّي: enshroud me in the funeral shroud

ai.seo_question: What did Rasul Allah (صلى الله عليه وآله) instruct Ali (عليه السلام) to do at the time of his death?
ai.summary: This hadith recounts the final instruction of Rasul Allah (صلى الله عليه وآله) to Amir al-Mu'minin Ali (عليه السلام) at the time of his passing. It highlights the intimate trust placed in Ali (عليه السلام) regarding the Prophet’s burial rites and the transmission of what he would convey thereafter.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Al Qasim Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Abu Hamza, from Ibn Abu Saeed, from Aban Bin Taghlub, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘When the death presented itself to Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>, Ali<sup>asws</sup> came over to him<sup>asws</sup>, so he<sup>saww</sup> entered his<sup>saww</sup> head (to be near to his<sup>asws</sup> head), then said: ‘O Ali<sup>asws</sup>! When I<sup>saww</sup> pass away, so wash me<sup>saww</sup> and enshroud me<sup>saww</sup>, then sit me<sup>saww</sup> up and ask me<sup>saww</sup>, and write down (the answers)’.
en.sarwar: 8. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn abu Hamza from ibn abu Sa‘id from Aban ibn Taghlib from abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) who has said the following.

“When the Messenger of Allah was about to leave this world Ali (a.s.) came in to see him he (the Messenger of Allah) placed his (Ali’s) head under the blanket and said, “O Ali, when I will die, wash my body and shroud it then place me in a sitting posture then ask me and write down.”
